models_evaluated: Raven (custom RAG system with vector search and LLM)

links.outcome: Completeness and correctness of RAG answers versus pathologist-generated reference answers
links.effect: Raven's responses were totally complete and correct in 92.0% of 88 CFR-addressed questions; performance declined significantly on questions not addressed in the CFR, confirming grounding.
links.quote: Compared to answers generated manually by a board-certified pathologist, Raven's responses were judged to be totally complete and correct in 92.0% of those 88 cases, with little irrelevant content and a low potential for regulatory or medical error.

screen.reason: The study tests the implementation of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to ground LLM responses in federal clinical laboratory regulations using synthetic regulatory queries evaluated by a board-certified pathologist.
